[[File:Leymus racemosus (Lam.) Tzvel. 1.JPG|thumb|Mammoth wild rye (''Leymus racemosus'')]]

'''''Leymus''''' is a [[genus]] of plants in the grass family [[Poaceae]] (Gramineae). It is widespread across Europe, Asia, and the Americas.<ref name=j/><ref>[https://www.biodiversitylibrary.org/page/43043#page/119/mode/1up Hochstetter, Christian Ferdinand Friedrich. 1848.  Flora 31(7): 118, in footnote] in German</ref><ref>[http://www.efloras.org/florataxon.aspx?flora_id=2&taxon_id=118489 Flora of China Vol. 22 Page 387 ''Leymus'' Hochstetter]</ref><ref>[http://bonap.net/NAPA/TaxonMaps/Genus/County/Leymus Biota of North America Program 2013 county distribution maps]</ref>

Butterflies whose caterpillars feed on ''Leymus'' include the [[Zabulon skipper]].
